playbooks.name: SEO audit (pro)
playbooks.description: Full SEO health check: which SEO plugin is live, sitemap reachable, per-post title/description quality on the most important pages, and fixes applied only where the owner asked.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: WooCommerce catalog audit
playbooks.description: Shop health: system status, product inventory and gaps, review queue, coupon usage sanity, out-of-stock list and order pipeline counts.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: WooCommerce first-sale readiness
playbooks.description: Pre-launch shop check: payment gateway live, shipping zone present, tax class sane, first product complete, welcome coupon tested, order pipeline dry-run.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Email deliverability check
playbooks.description: Make transactional email trustworthy: admin email sanity, test message, plugin-based SMTP detection, notification inventory.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Backup drill
playbooks.description: Prove reversibility before you need it: snapshot, checkpoint, a reversible change, verify the journal, and rehearse the restore path.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Staging to production content promotion
playbooks.description: Promote reviewed content changes: verify the production snapshot, apply the agreed edits, sweep dev URLs out, and keep the journal as the rollback path.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Accessibility pass
playbooks.description: A practical a11y baseline: global styles contrast review, image alt-text coverage, heading structure spot-check on key pages, and safe fixes.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Stale content refresh
playbooks.description: Find the oldest still-relevant published posts, refresh facts and dates where safe, and leave an audit trail via a checkpoint before writing.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: GDPR / privacy pass
playbooks.description: Privacy baseline: privacy policy page present, comment settings conservative, user inventory, and a moderation sweep of pending items.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Speed pass
playbooks.description: Performance hygiene without third-party claims: media sizes complete, unused media listed, transient garbage collected, cron queue sane, core/plugins up to date, Site Health clean.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Comment spam purge
playbooks.description: Measure the spam backlog, purge it reversibly (spam flag, never hard delete), then harden the comment settings so the backlog does not rebuild.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: User offboarding (safe)
playbooks.description: Remove a person's access without destroying their work: sessions killed, content reassigned, role downgraded or user deleted with explicit reassignment targets.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Broken links sweep
playbooks.description: Scan for broken links, fix internal ones in place, and add 301 redirects for moved URLs instead of editing external targets.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Plugin vulnerability triage
playbooks.description: Inventory every installed plugin, flag abandoned or inactive ones, apply pending updates with a checkpoint, and probe for conflicts after updating.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP

playbooks.name: Multilingual starter
playbooks.description: Prepare a site for two languages: language inventory, per-post language assignment, translation linking, and a duplicated menu structure check.
playbooks.author: 1ShotWP
